tagline: A tiny bash-only coding agent, wired to local models to fix a one-line bug

scenes.narration: Day 56: mini-swe-agent, a coding agent of about a hundred lines. We asked local models to fix one bug in our own repo.

scenes.heading: What is it?
bullets: From the SWE-bench and SWE-agent team
Agent class: 151 lines of code in v2.4.6
scenes.narration: It comes from the SWE-bench team. Its only tool is bash, and the agent class is about a hundred and fifty lines of code.

steps.narration: The model replies with a bash command, and the agent appends every output to one linear history.
Each command runs in a fresh shell inside a container without network, until the model echoes a submit marker.

scenes.heading: What we found
scenes.caption: Local-model runs that fixed the bug
scenes.narration: Only gemma4 fixed it, four times out of six. Qwen models never did. A sed command without escaped brackets silently changed nothing, and five runs submitted anyway.
